ns2:course.label: Env Eng Principles, Biological
ns2:course.description: Application of principles of biochemistry and microbiology to air and water quality, wastes, and their engineering management; biological mediated changes in water and in domestic and industrial wastewater. 4 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: CEE 443.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 4 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: CEE 443.
